# Flutter

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from flutter/lang.json and flutter/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//flutter:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//flutter:defs.bzl", "flutter_gen_l10n", "flutter_library", "flutter_test")
```

## Rules

### `flutter_gen_l10n`

No documentation.

### `flutter_library`

```python
flutter_library(name, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_library; fonts_json assets must come from font_files.

### `flutter_test`

```python
flutter_test(name, *, main = None, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_test. main is name.dart, then test/name.dart, else the single src.

### `flutter_application`

```python
flutter_application(name, *, main = None, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_application. main is name.dart, then lib/main.dart, else the single src.

### `flutter_web_app`

```python
flutter_web_app(name, *, main = None, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_web_app. main is name.dart, then lib/main.dart, else the single src.

### `flutter_web_bundle`

```python
flutter_web_bundle(name, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_web_bundle, for dart2js or canvaskit builds.

### `flutter_android_app`

```python
flutter_android_app(name, application, package_name, android_abi = "arm64", visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_android_app. An unknown android_abi fails when the target is analyzed.

### `flutter_ios_app`

```python
flutter_ios_app(name, application, bundle_id, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_ios_app. Reads runner files from ios/Runner/ in the calling package and builds only for iOS.

## API docs

Tool: `dart doc`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/dart:defs.bzl", "dart_doc_shard")
```

### `dart_doc_shard`

Converts one dart_library public API into a DocIr shard with the pinned `dart doc`.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lib` | `label` | yes | The documented dart_library. |
| `package` | `string` | no | Package segment of the symbol ids; defaults to the Dart package name of lib. |
| `_extract` | `label` | no |  |

Build the docs with `tools/dx docs`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).
